description_en: Produces one or more videos into a finished video. You can submit source videos directly through the timeline parameter, or create an online editing project first and then submit it for production
description_zh: 将一个或多个视频合成为成品。可以通过时间线参数直接提交源视频，也可以先创建云剪辑工程，再提交合成
kebab_example: aliyun vod produce-editing-project-video --project-id fb2101bf24b4cb318787dc0000 --timeline VideoTracks_:_VideoTrackClips_:_MediaId_:_cc3308ac59615a54328bc34430000_,_MediaId_:_da87a9cff645cd88bc6d8326e40000 --title Cloud_Clip_Project_Title --description Cloud_clip_project_description --cover-url https://example.aliyundoc.com/6AB4D0E1E1C74468883510000.png --media-metadata Description_:_Synthetic_Video_Description_,_Title_:_Synthetic_userData_test --produce-config TemplateGroupId_:_6d11e25ea30a4c465435c740000 --user-data Extend_:_width_:1280,_id_:_028a8e56b1ebf6bb7afc740000_,_height_:720_,_MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_https://example.aliyundoc.com/2016-08-15/proxy/httpcallback/testcallback/_,_CallbackType_:_http --app-id app-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ProduceEditingProjectVideo

parameters.help_en:
The online editing project ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com), choose Production Center > Video Editing, and view the ID.
Obtain the value of the ProjectId parameter returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69048.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
云剪辑工程ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择制作中心 > 视频剪辑，查看ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69048.html接口创建工程时，为返回参数ProjectId的值
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The timeline of the online editing project in JSON format. For more information about the structure, see [Timeline](~~52839#07bc7fe0f2xuh~~).
Make sure that each VideoTrackClip object contains a valid MediaId. Otherwise, the request fails
parameters.help_zh:
云剪辑工程时间线，JSON格式。具体结构定义，请参见[Timeline](~~52839#07bc7fe0f2xuh~~)。
请确保每个VideoTrackClip对象中都包含有效的MediaId，否则会导致请求失败
parameters.name: timeline

parameters.help_en: The title of the online editing project
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The description of the online editing project
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The thumbnail of the online editing project
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en: The metadata of the produced video in JSON format. For more information about the structure, see [MediaMetadata](~~52839#title-rtf-ry5-gjp~~)
parameters.help_zh: 合成视频的元数据，JSON格式。具体结构定义，请参见[MediaMetadata](~~52839#title-rtf-ry5-gjp~~)
parameters.name: media_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The production configuration in JSON format. For more information about the structure, see [ProduceConfig](~~52839#title-ybl-7cs-y7d~~).
<notice>
The StorageLocation field can be ignored when the file storage region is Shanghai. It is required when the file storage region is in other regions.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
合成配置，JSON格式。具体结构定义，请参见[ProduceConfig](~~52839#title-ybl-7cs-y7d~~)。
<notice>
StorageLocation字段在文件存储地域为上海时，可以忽略；在文件存储地域为其他地域时，为必填项。
</notice>
parameters.name: produce_config

parameters.help_en:
The custom settings in JSON format. The maximum length is 256 characters. The settings support message callbacks and other configurations. For more information about the structure, see [UserData](~~86952#title-vz7-xzs-0c5~~).

To use the message callback in this parameter, configure the HTTP callback URL and select the corresponding callback event types in the console. Otherwise, the callback settings do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
自定义设置，为JSON字符串，最大允许256个字符，支持消息回调等设置。具体结构定义，请参见[UserData](~~86952#title-vz7-xzs-0c5~~)。

此参数中消息回调的使用前提是需要在控制台配置HTTP回调地址和勾选对应的回调事件类型才能使用，否则回调设置不生效
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。默认取值： app-1000000。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

MediaId.description_en:
The ID of the produced video.
The video production operation synchronously returns the ID of the produced video.
When MediaId is returned, the video production has entered the asynchronous processing phase
MediaId.description_zh:
合成的视频ID。
视频合成接口同步返回合成的视频ID。
接口返回MediaId，表示视频合成已进入异步处理阶段
